clinics.name: Maryborough Veterinary Practice
clinics.published_hours_summary: Vet on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. After-hours calls go via VetCheck on the clinic number.
clinics.notes: Quoted: "For emergencies outside practice open hours, we have a vet on call 24 hours a day and 7 days a week. MVP uses a service called VetCheck to take after hours calls. When you call the number above, follow the options / instructions and your call will automatically be transferred to VetCheck." Possible outcomes include attending the clinic with the on-call vet, a large-animal property visit, waiting until normal hours, or, after consulting the on-call vet, being asked to visit an Emergency Centre in Melbourne. "Please note that if you have a vet clinic closer to where you live who offers on call services, you may be asked to contact that clinic instead." clinics.name: Gippsland Veterinary Group after-hours pathway
clinics.published_hours_summary: On-call every night, weekend and public holiday. Companion-animal after-hours from Leongatha and/or Wonthaggi; call nearest GVG clinic and press 1 (pets) or 2 (livestock/equine).
clinics.notes: Quoted: "GVG offers an after-hours service for pets, horses and livestock, every day of the year. Our dedicated vets and nurses are rostered on-call every night, weekend and public holiday. While our clinics are not staffed on-site 24/7, a veterinarian is always available to provide advice over the phone and can attend in-clinic or on-farm if required." "Companion animals: … the after-hours service for our seven companion animal clinics is provided from Leongatha and/or Wonthaggi Veterinary Clinics only." Seasonal rotation. "After-hours care is primarily for existing clients, a telehealth consultation fee is applicable to new/inactive companion animal clients if the initial contact is after hours." Also: "Our after-hours service is available to all clients. Active GVG patients receive their initial phone consultation free of charge." Not strictly existing-clients-only, but active clients are favoured on fees. "We do not provide 24-hour on-site monitoring." Always call before arriving. Initial companion-animal telehealth consult is free for active patients. Wonthaggi clinic: 290 White Road, Wonthaggi VIC 3995, (03) 5672 1044, wonthaggi@gippsvet.com.au. Other clinic numbers: Foster (03) 5682 2757; Grantville (03) 5672 1060; Inverloch (03) 5674 2408; Mirboo North (03) 5668 1225; Newhaven / Phillip Island (03) 5956 7262; Livestock & Equine (03) 5662 2251. Leongatha and Wonthaggi consult hours include Sunday 10:30am–12:00pm with a surcharge; public-holiday weekends are after-hours service only.
clinics.public_hours: On-call every night, weekend and public holiday. Companion-animal after-hours from Leongatha and/or Wonthaggi; call nearest GVG clinic and press 1 (pets) or 2 (livestock/equine).
clinics.previous_review_notes: Fee difference for new/inactive clients should be shown clearly if listed.

clinics.notes: Quoted: "Emergency? We're available 24/7." "Gippsland Veterinary Hospital – Maffra sees emergencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Please call first, so the team can get ready for you." Regular opening hours listed as Mon–Fri 8am–5:30pm, Sat 8am–12pm, Sun closed, so this reads as 24/7 emergency availability rather than a continuously staffed 24-hour hospital. The page also points uncertain cases to Vetriage. Existing-clients-only not stated. The clinic page printed the postcode as 3830; Maffra's locality postcode is 3860 (also used by Greencross Vets Morwell when referring here). Greencross Vets Morwell (extended hours only; closed Sunday) refers after-hours emergencies to this hospital. Re-checked 26 November 2026: the emergency, contact and homepage headers all print "10 Johnson Street, Maffra VIC 3830", and none print 3860. 3830 is not in the Victorian locality list; Maffra is 3860.
